lookup_mob_by_id: use MOBS_BY_ID to look up a Minecraft mob name by its numeric entity ID
iterate_all_mobs: iterate over MOBS_BY_ID to list all Minecraft mob IDs and their names
check_mob_exists: check if a mob ID key exists in the MOBS_BY_ID dictionary
get_mob_count: get the total number of Minecraft mobs defined in MOBS_BY_ID using len()
reverse_lookup_mob_id: build a reverse mapping from mob name to ID by inverting MOBS_BY_ID
